original.question: What is the basic-to-headline earnings bridge for H1 2026 and H1 2025 (continuing and discontinued), and were any H1 2026 once-off/option/associate items excluded from the nil-adjustment core reconciliation?
original.target_section: D003 income statement / headline earnings per share note
original.evidence_required: Signed basic loss to headline loss reconciliation (Rm) for H1 2026 and H1 2025, continuing and discontinued, listing each exclusion (asset disposals, impairments, associate items); confirmation whether any H1 2026 adjustments met the core-earnings policy criteria
original.closure_condition: Basic-to-headline bridge shown and summing, and H1 2026 core adjustments (or their absence) explained; benign explanation (e.g. no qualifying items) acceptable; forecast consequence: reliability of core earnings as a run-rate base

proposed.answer: Basic-to-headline bridge shown and sums for H1 FY26, H1 FY25 and FY25. Total: H1 FY26 loss (63) with nil headline adjustments = headline loss (63); H1 FY25 loss (64) less profit on disposal of business (100) plus tax 29 = headline loss (135); FY25 (238) less (100) plus 29 = (309). Continuing operations carry no headline adjustments in any period (H1 FY26 (63), H1 FY25 (122), FY25 (113)). Discontinued: H1 FY26 nil; H1 FY25 earnings 58 less (71) = headline loss (13); FY25 (125) less (71) = (196). H1 FY26 has no qualifying once-off/option/associate exclusions, consistent with nil core adjustments rather than a policy change.
